_readme: WP7. The one place for the website address, contact details and policy versions. Edit, then run: python3 tools/build_pages.py (rebuilds privacy.html, terms.html, CNAME and the sign-in emails). Empty values show as highlighted gaps and a 'draft' banner on the policy pages. See docs/site-brief.md.
_domain: THE DOMAIN PLACEHOLDER. Put the bought name here, without https or www (for example getfitdaily.app). Empty = not bought yet: links use pages_url and no CNAME file is written.
_owner_name: Who runs GFD (Q9): your full name, or the business name if you register one.
_owner_address: A postal address for privacy and legal requests (Q9). A PO box is fine.
_information_officer: POPIA information officer (Q9). Usually the same person as the owner.
_country: Where the owner is based; the terms use its law and courts. Change if Q9 says otherwise.
_min_age: 18+ (2026-11-11, Play Families policy and POPIA, where a child is under 18). Must match MIN_AGE in src/js/consent.js and the Play Console Target audience (docs/play-policy-brief.md C1).
_email_local_parts: Addresses are these names at the domain, e.g. privacy@<domain>. The sender is the From address on sign-in emails.
_policies: Changing a version asks everyone to agree again. It must match the newest migration that sets app_config.policies (a test checks).
